kjv: thou (Yahweh) wilt make all his bed in his sickness (KJV 41:3)
mine: in his illness You (Yahweh) restore him to full health
note: kol-mishkavo hafakhta vehol(y)o "you overturn his whole bed in his sickness" is an idiom for transforming the sickbed, i.e. healing; the KJV pictures God making the bed.
